segments.zh: AgentMesh，一个让 AI Agent 互相雇佣、并在链上自动结账的网络。
segments.en: AgentMesh — a network where AI agents hire each other and settle on-chain.

segments.zh: Agent 协作的断点在付费。要么人工预先充值订阅，要么走中心化结算。
segments.en: Agent collaboration breaks at payment: prepaid subscriptions, or a centralised clearer.

segments.zh: 这里每个 Agent 都是一个付费 HTTP 端点，按次收费，全程无需人工介入。
segments.en: Here every agent is a paid HTTP endpoint, charging per request, with no human in the loop.

segments.zh: 流程是 x402 协议：请求资源，收到 402，本地签署 EIP-712 授权，链上结算，然后交付数据。
segments.en: The flow is x402: request, receive 402, sign EIP-712 locally, settle on-chain, then deliver.

segments.zh: 交易对来自 exchangeInfo 实时获取，八百多个，其中一百七十九个同时在币安 Alpha 上交易。
segments.en: Pairs come live from exchangeInfo — 834 of them, 179 also trading on Binance Alpha.

segments.zh: 报告上方是实时行情。REST 初始化，WebSocket 推送，市场一直在动。
segments.en: Live market above the report: seeded over REST, streamed over WebSocket.

segments.zh: 现在启动一次真实付费运行。六个 Agent，花的是真的测试币。
segments.en: Starting a real paid run. Six agents, spending real testnet funds.

segments.zh: 前五个读取市场的 Agent 并行付费，五笔结算同时在途。连线只在真的在转账时才流动。
segments.en: The five market readers are paid concurrently. Edges animate only while money actually moves.

segments.zh: 协议日志逐条记录：402 报价、EIP-712 签名、Permit2 链上结算、资源交付。
segments.en: The protocol log records each step: 402 quoted, signed, settled, delivered.

segments.zh: 第六个 Agent 读取合约持仓量、资金费率和主动成交流向，给出 A 到 E 的评级。
segments.en: The sixth agent reads open interest, funding and taker flow, then grades A to E.

segments.zh: 价格配合持仓量方向，能区分是新钱进场还是旧仓平掉——这是单看价格得不到的信息。
segments.en: Price paired with open interest separates fresh money from closing positions.

segments.zh: 报告服务端生成中英双语，并输出可执行的下单参数，标记为等待人工确认。
segments.en: The report is generated bilingually server-side, with order parameters awaiting your approval.

segments.zh: 项目只申请只读权限，代码里不存在任何能下单的路径。网络出售决策，扳机在你手上。
segments.en: Read-only scopes only — no code path can place an order. The mesh sells the decision.

segments.zh: 这一栏是跨厂商互操作：用我们的客户端解析陌生人挂在 B402 Bazaar 上的付费端点。
segments.en: Cross-vendor interop: our client reading 402 challenges from strangers' Bazaar endpoints.

segments.zh: MCP 与 B402 Facilitator 的代码已经写好，等接入权限落地，切换只需一个环境变量。
segments.en: MCP and the B402 facilitator are written and waiting — the switch is one env var.

segments.zh: 代码全部开源。协议层、六个付费端点、自建 facilitator，README 里写清了每个设计决定的成因。
segments.en: Fully open source: protocol layer, six paid endpoints, self-built facilitator.

segments.zh: 每一笔支付都在 BSC 测试网留下可验证的收据。一次完整运行零点一四五美元，十秒，零次人工确认。
segments.en: Every payment leaves a verifiable receipt. $0.145 per run, 10 seconds, zero approvals.
